{{Quote|Holojournal Entry #1983712. During our most recent trip to the Noonian sector, L3 and I met an Er'kit gunrunner who presented us with an interesting opportunity.|Lando Calrissian, in a holojournal|<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref>}}
The '''Noonian sector''' was a [[sector]] in [[the galaxy]]. [[Time|Sometime]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[L3-37]] met with an [[Er'Kit (species)|Er'Kit]] [[arms dealer]] and acquired a shipment of [[All Terrain Defense Turret]] [[walker]]s. Eventually, Calrissian and L3-37 were [[Ambush in the Halthor sector|ambushed]] in the [[Halthor sector]] when an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[interdictor]] dropped out from [[hyperspace]]. As a result of the ambush, Calrissian lost a majority of his shipment of walkers that he acquired from the arms dealer.<ref name="Commander" />

After the [[Battle for Tatooine]], [[Tatooine rebel cell|Saponza's Gang]] came in possession of Calrissian's holorecordings, including [[Holojournal Entry 1983712|Holojournal Entry #1983712]], and received chatter from the criminal underworld of older walkers with heavy firepower being utilized. [[Saponza]] deduced that someone must have found Calrissian's shipment, and that people would be hunting for the rest of the cargo. Saponza and [[Saponza's partner|his partner]] embarked on a [[mission to recover Lando Calrissian's shipment]].<ref name="Commander" />
